mechanism: Naloxone antagonizes opioid effects while carisoprodol's active metabolite (meprobamate) has CNS depressant properties; naloxone may precipitate withdrawal if carisoprodol is used with concurrent opioids, and combined CNS depression risk exists.
action: Monitor for reduced carisoprodol efficacy or CNS depression; use naloxone cautiously in patients on carisoprodol, especially if concurrent opioid use is present; consider alternative muscle relaxants if opioid reversal is needed.
